_comment: Fish Audio (api.fish.audio) — the third cloud voice SUB/WAVE itself offers, so a station already paying for it can point the call line at the same account. Set Endpoint to https://api.fish.audio and put the key in the Fish Audio box under Voice. The voice is a Fish reference id, and the right default is no choice at all: 'Station's voice for this DJ' passes the persona's own configured voice string through untouched, which for a persona the station already speaks through Fish IS its reference id. Fish publishes no OpenAI-style voice list, so ignore what Reload voice list shows. Asks for raw PCM at 24k so the pace meter and the sample-rate probe both work; press Test voice after wiring it, and read what it says.
